name: Ananya Rao

Skilled in Python-based analytics, statistical modeling, and translating business problems into data-driven solutions. Experienced in end-to-end model development, from data wrangling to deployment.

Collaborate with product teams to define data requirements and success metrics
Build automated data pipelines using Python and SQL for reporting and analytics
Conduct A/B tests to evaluate model performance and business impact
Present findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders
Cleaned and preprocessed transactional datasets for fraud detection models
Assisted senior data scientists in building classification models using scikit-learn
Created dashboards to track key business metrics using Tableau
Performed exploratory data analysis to identify trends in customer behavior
